report_name: Attacker Pleads Guilty in Massive 2024 Snowflake Breach Campaign

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker logged in with legitimate, albeit stolen, user credentials to gain unauthorized access to Snowflake customer cloud environments.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: After gaining access to Snowflake tenants, the attacker exfiltrated over 100 million records stored within the data cloud.

attack_patterns.name: Credential Stuffing
attack_patterns.description: The attacker launched a widespread credential stuffing campaign, systematically testing a large collection of credentials stolen from other sources against Snowflake customer accounts.

attack_patterns.name: Brute Force
attack_patterns.description: The credential stuffing campaign was described as a subset of brute-force attacks, leveraging automated tools to test large volumes of credentials against Snowflake login endpoints.

campaigns.name: 2024 Snowflake Breach Campaign
campaigns.description: A widespread credential stuffing campaign throughout 2024 that targeted Snowflake customer accounts not enforcing multi-factor authentication, resulting in the theft of over 100 million records.

identities.name: Snowflake
identities.description: A cloud data platform whose customer tenants were targeted in a large-scale credential stuffing campaign. The platform itself was not breached.

indicators.name: Snowflake Failed Login Indicative of Credential Stuffing
indicators.pattern:
title: Snowflake Failed Login Indicative of Credential Stuffing
id: 7c5b9d1a-4f8e-4a1b-8c9d-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: 'Detects failed login attempts in Snowflake with the specific error for invalid credentials. A high volume of these events from a single source may indicate a credential stuffing attack, as seen in the 2024 Snowflake breach campaign.'
references:
  - https://www.rescana.com/post/snowflake-data-breach-analysis-credential-based-cloud-intrusion-exposes-over-100-million-records-2024-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
tags:
  - attack.t1110.004
  - attack.credential_access
level: medium
logsource:
  category: cloud
  service: snowflake
detection:
  keywords:
    - 'LOGIN_FAILED_INVALID_USER_OR_PASSWORD'
  condition: keywords
indicators.description: Detects a specific Snowflake failed login event type which, in high volumes, can indicate a credential stuffing attack similar to the one described in the article.
